import.title: Import students from Excel
import.adminOnly: Only an owner or admin can import students.
import.templateHint: The template has Bangla and English headers. Your own Excel file works too; you match the columns in the next step.
import.rule1: One student per row. Name, class and guardian phone are required.
import.rule2: Bangla or English digits both work. Birth registration has 17 digits.
import.rule3: Uploading the same file again adds no one twice (matched on student ID or birth registration).
import.uploadHint: Students are enrolled in the current academic year.
import.chooseFile: Choose an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file
import.doneText: Done. See each row below or download the report.
import.failedText: The import did not finish. Try again or ask for help.

import.mappingHint: Which column of the file holds what. Matched automatically; change any that are wrong and check again.
import.errorFileInvalid: The file could not be read
import.errorFileTooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB
import.errorTooManyRows: At most {max} rows at a time
import.errorNoYear: There is no current academic year. Make one current in institute setup first.

import.err_STUDENT_LIMIT: the plan's student limit is reached; contact Jantrik
import.err_GUARDIAN_PHONE_TWICE: both guardians have the same phone
import.err_ROW_REJECTED: this row could not be added; check it and try again
import.err_GUARDIAN_NAME_NEEDED: several guardians have this phone; add the guardian name to pick one

platformInstitutes.title: Institutes
platformInstitutes.hint: Every institute on Jantrik: status, plan, owner and usage. Never their students or guardians.
platformInstitutes.emptyAllHint: Add the first one: it starts in trial and its owner gets an invitation.
platformInstitutes.emptyFilteredHint: Change the search or the filters.
platformInstitutes.newHint: The institute starts in trial with its type’s classes and subjects. The owner sees the invitation after signing in with their mobile number; no SMS is sent, so tell them yourself.
platformInstitutes.name: Institute name
platformInstitutes.slugHint: Lowercase English letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. alo-coaching. It cannot be changed later.
platformInstitutes.modulesHint: Core (students, staff, setup) is always on.
platformInstitutes.ownerHint: The person who runs the institute. They get an Owner invitation for 14 days.
platformInstitutes.ownerPhoneHint: They sign in with a code sent to this number.
platformInstitutes.planHint: Prices are per month. Invoices come later; this records what was agreed.
platformInstitutes.dueDaysHint: An invoice is due this many days after it is issued.
platformInstitutes.trialEndsHint: Optional. After it the institute stays in trial, with a warning here.
platformInstitutes.smsCeilingHint: A ceiling: the institute’s own daily limit applies if it is lower. Empty: none.
platformInstitutes.createNote: The owner’s invitation is valid for {days} days.
platformInstitutes.created: {name} added. Tell the owner to sign in.
platformInstitutes.suspendedAlert: Suspended since {date}. Nobody at the institute can use Jantrik until you reactivate it. Its data is kept.
platformInstitutes.trialEndedAlert: The trial ended on {date}. The institute stays in trial until you activate it.
platformInstitutes.ownerDetailHint: Once the owner accepts, the institute manages its staff itself.
platformInstitutes.inviteOwnerHint: For an institute without an owner, e.g. after cancelling an invitation sent to a wrong number.
platformInstitutes.modulesDetailHint: Changes apply on the institute’s next action.
platformInstitutes.limitsHint: Admissions and imports stop at the student limit.
platformInstitutes.noPlanText: No plan yet. This institute was added before plans existed.
platformInstitutes.suspendHint: Suspending stops everyone at the institute at once. Nothing is deleted.
platformInstitutes.reactivateHint: Reactivating lets everyone back in. It returns to: {status}.
platformInstitutes.reasonHint: Kept in the activity log of both sides.
platformInstitutes.errorCheckForm: Fix the fields marked in red.
platformInstitutes.errorSlug: 3–40 lowercase English letters, digits or hyphens (not a reserved word)
platformInstitutes.errorSlugTaken: Another institute already uses this link name.
platformInstitutes.errorMoney: An amount in taka, e.g. 25 or 25.50
platformInstitutes.errorLimit: A whole number, or empty for no limit
platformInstitutes.errorYear: Give the year a name and an end after its start.
platformInstitutes.errorAlreadyStaff: This person is already staff at the institute.
platformInstitutes.errorHasOwner: The institute already has an active owner.
platformInstitutes.errorOwnerInvited: An owner invitation is already pending.
platformInstitutes.errorNotReinvitable: Only an expired or declined invitation can be sent again.
platformInstitutes.errorNotInvited: This owner has accepted; the institute manages them now.
platformInstitutes.errorBadStatus: Not possible in the institute’s current status.
platformInstitutes.editPlanHint: Changes apply to invoices issued from now on; issued invoices stay as they are.
platformInstitutes.activateHint: The trial ends and the institute becomes active. If it has a plan, invoices start with next month (you can change that in the plan).
platformInstitutes.trialHint: In trial: no invoices. Activate it when the trial ends; suspending stops everyone at once.

platformBilling.title: Billing
platformBilling.hint: Issue a month’s invoices, record what institutes pay, and follow up what is overdue. Nothing is suspended automatically.
platformBilling.generateHint: For every active institute with a plan whose billing has started. Running it again for the same month issues nothing twice.
platformBilling.generated: {n, plural, =0 {No new invoices.} one {{count} invoice issued.} other {{count} invoices issued.}}
platformBilling.generatedFor: {month}: {n, plural, =0 {no new invoices} one {{count} invoice issued} other {{count} invoices issued}}

platformBilling.referenceHint: bKash transaction ID or bank slip number.
platformBilling.paidInFull: Payment recorded. The invoice is paid in full.

platformBilling.overdueSummary: {n, plural, one {{count} invoice is overdue} other {{count} invoices are overdue}}: {amount} to pay.
platformBilling.openSummary: {n, plural, one {{count} unpaid invoice} other {{count} unpaid invoices}}: {amount} to pay.

platformUsage.title: Usage and cost
platformUsage.hint: What the platform cost in a month: SMS sent by institutes and as login codes, each at the rate it was sent at. Counts only.
platformUsage.institutesLine: {total} institutes now: {active} active, {trial} in trial, {suspended} suspended

platformSettings.title: Settings
platformSettings.hint: Platform-wide settings. Every change is in the activity log.
platformSettings.smsCostHint: What one SMS segment costs Jantrik. New SMS use it; sent ones keep their cost.
platformSettings.saved: Saved. New SMS use this rate.
platformSettings.updatedDefault: The starting rate; not changed yet.
platformSettings.errorCost: An amount in taka from ৳0 to ৳100, e.g. 0.30

onboarding.title: Set up {institute}
onboarding.subtitle: A few steps to get started. Skip any of them; you can come back from the dashboard.
onboarding.yearText: It was made from the dates Jantrik was given. Change the name or the dates if they are not right.
onboarding.classesText: The {classLevel} list comes from your institute type. Add the {section} each one has (for example A and B).
onboarding.shiftsText: If you run, say, a morning and a day {shift}, add them here. With just one, skip this step.
onboarding.teachersText: Add teachers by mobile number. No SMS is sent: they see the invitation when they log in with OTP on that number.
onboarding.noTeachers: Nobody else has been added yet.
onboarding.studentsText: Upload an Excel or CSV file. Every row is checked before anything is saved. You can also add a {student} at a time later.
onboarding.attendanceText: How often do teachers take attendance, and should guardians get an SMS when a {student} is absent?
onboarding.attendanceMore: Off days, holidays and the SMS text are in the attendance settings.
onboarding.doneText: You can change any of this later in Institute setup, Staff and the attendance settings.

appearance.presetText_ENGLISH_MEDIUM: White, ink black and a touch of gold: refined.
